verdict.rationale: Circle documents several ways for a business to hold stablecoin balances. Developer-controlled wallets are described as custodial wallets for treasury. Circle Mint accounts are open to qualified businesses through an application, which states gating honestly. Managed CPN mode has Circle handle custody, and Gateway offers a chain-abstracted USDC balance. However, the evidence does not state account availability or which geographies are eligible for these custodial accounts; the supported-countries endpoint is scoped to CPN payouts. missing for 10: stated geographic availability of custodial/Mint accounts, documented eligibility criteria behind 'qualified businesses', independent or hands-on corroboration of business custodial balances.

support.subject: As a finance lead, my business can hold a stablecoin balance on the platform — documented custodial accounts with stated availability, geographies, and any gating quoted honestly

citations.quote: Qualified businesses can apply for a Circle Mint account to readily convert USD to and from USDC at no additional cost.
use-developer-controlled-wallets ... (custodial wallets for payouts and treasury)
Managed: Circle handles licensing, custody, compliance, treasury, and settlement on your behalf.
Circle Gateway allows you to create a chain-abstracted USDC balance and transfer it instantly to any supported destination chain.
